input.overview: The decisive route is Atom Smasher Multiball. Put five balls into the upper-left Atom Smasher; the fifth lock starts five-ball Multiball with a 12x playfield multiplier. Because the lock is physical and the lower eject can be weak, watch every serve and release instead of assuming a rejected ball was counted. Use the Particle Separator and Anti-Gravity ramps for safer scoring only when the Atom Smasher feed is not under control.
input.simpleOverview: Put five balls into the upper-left Atom Smasher. The fifth lock starts five-ball Multiball with a 12x playfield multiplier, so keep the lock as the priority and watch each weak eject or release carefully.

quickInfo.summary: Each successful Atom Smasher entry advances the physical lock.

quickInfo.name: Use 12x
quickInfo.summary: Keep the ball count alive while the playfield multiplier is active.

steps.text: Shoot the upper-left Atom Smasher and confirm that each ball is accepted into the physical lock.
Repeat the Atom Smasher shot until five balls have been locked; the fifth lock starts five-ball Multiball.
During Multiball, keep shooting controllable switches and major features while the 12x playfield multiplier is active.
Track weak or partial Atom Smasher ejections by sight so a mechanical rejection is not mistaken for qualified progress.

alternatives.title: Use the two center ramps
alternatives.when: Use these when the Atom Smasher feed is rejecting or the upper-left kickers are too weak for reliable locks.

steps.text: Shoot the Particle Separator ramp across the upper playfield or the center Anti-Gravity ramp for safer controlled progress.
Return to the Atom Smasher route once the ball is settled and the lock mechanism is reading cleanly.
Treat the fifth lock as the scoring threshold rather than spreading risk across every feature.
Once five-ball play begins, prioritize survival because every live switch benefits from the 12x multiplier.

machineSetup: Confirm ball count, Extra Ball and Special conversions, multiplayer lock sharing, and any competition setting that changes physical-lock behavior.
Test all five Atom Smasher captures and releases, the lower-ball and raise-ball ejects, Particle Separator and Anti-Gravity ramps, both target banks, trough, and all flippers.

playfieldReferences.label: Atom Smasher
playfieldReferences.description: The upper-left physical lock that starts five-ball Multiball on the fifth accepted ball.

playfieldReferences.label: Particle Separator ramp
playfieldReferences.description: The ramp crossing the upper playfield above the central features.

playfieldReferences.label: Anti-Gravity ramp
playfieldReferences.description: The large translucent center ramp and return assembly.

cautions.issue: A weak Atom Smasher eject or partial capture can make physical lock progress look different from the mechanism's actual state.
cautions.response: Watch the ball enter, settle, and release; verify the lock count before committing another shot.
